errors.text_span: с равномерни интервали от една година
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has uniform one-year intervals, but the labels on the chart (2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020) clearly show two-year intervals for most of the axis.

errors.text_span: и се движи почти хоризонтално до 2016 г.
errors.evidence: Describing the line as moving 'almost horizontally' until 2016 is an over-generalization. The value increases from approximately 0.1 million to 0.8 million in this period, which is a noticeable growth, even if it is slower than the later period.
